title: Man. Post. Cap. X: PLAC open — from Rom. 5.13 you draw an argument that collapses on your prior case
pass_a_gloss: Placeus opens Cap. X: from the next verse, where Paul proves that sin entered the world and all sinned, you gather some argument that rests on your prior case—already refuted and buried in absurdities—and that you yourself promptly destroy.
pass_b_english: From the following verse, by which the Apostle proves what he had said—that sin entered into the world and all men sinned—you gather I know not what argument, which both rests on that prior case of yours already refuted by me and overwhelmed with absurdities, and is continually destroyed by you yourself.
source_text: SED pergamus. Ex versu sequente, quo Apostolus id quod dixerat, peccatum introiisse in mundum & omnes homines peccasse, probat, tu nescio quid argumenti colligis, quod & praecedente illo tuo a me iam refutato ac absurdis obruto nititur, & a te ipso continuo destruitur.

choices.choice: Rom 5.13 argument rests on already-refuted prior case
